## Initial release

- Renders `.crv` pages alongside Markdown pages in MkDocs.
- Configures Carve extensions per site, with heading permalinks enabled by
  default.
- Supports Unicode/Twemoji symbols and project-defined symbol maps.
- Depends only on published `carve-lang` packages; release verification uses
  0.1.2 and requires no Rust toolchain for wheel consumers.

The release builds both wheel and source distribution and validates their
metadata before PyPI trusted publishing.
